segments.line: I just got back from Chicago.
Oh, nice. (flat) -- then a dead beat

Grab one word and ask about it. "Chicago? What took you there?"
Chaos. The caterer didn't show up!
"No! So what did you eat?" ... The answer's in what they just said.
